<div class="card-body">
'''Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊デレク・“ホビー”・キルヴィアン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ビッグズと同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋２。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（スター・デストロイヤーが同じ場所にいるなら３）を加える。ローグ４を操縦するなら回避値に２を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Derek-Hobbie-Klivian-PSA-164089327.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビッグズ・ダークライターと共に帝国軍から脱走してきた。輸送船ランド・エクリプティックで反乱を起こしたエクリプティック・イヴエイダーズの一員。ホスの戦いではルークの編隊僚機をつとめた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Derek "Hobbie" Klivian.

'''Card text:'''
Power +2 when at the same location as Biggs. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if a Star Destroyer is at the same location). Adds 2 to maneuver if he pilots Rogue 4.

'''Lore:'''
He defected from the Empire with Biggs Darklighter. A member of the Ecliptic Evaders, who mutinied aboard the transport Rand Ecliptic. At the Battle of Hoth he flew as Luke's wingman.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
